Hi Caspar,

messages.body_plain:
Hi Michael,

It works!!! Thank you so much for putting your time into developing this package. I will definitely cite your article in my future work.

Best,
Nick

On Wednesday, February 20, 2019 at 8:51:31 AM UTC-6, michael.hallquist wrote:
> Hi Nick,
>
> Thanks for this example. The problem resulted from the package not having seen standardized sections from multilevel Monte Carlo outputs before. Unfortunately, for every variant on section formatting, we usually need to capture this uniquely within the section parser. I have now added a match for this case to the parser and verified that the development version of the package parses this as expected. I also identified an incidental problem with R-SQUARE parsing in multilevel outputs, where the section headers don't follow the usual Mplus conventions. Anyhow, this is fixed, too. You can install the development version using instructions here: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation
>
> Best,
> Michael
>
> On Sunday, January 20, 2019 at 4:02:28 PM UTC-5, Nick Chang wrote:
> > Hi groups,
> >
> > Since extractModelParameters has been deprecated, I tried to use readModels to extract the STDYX Standardization results from my simulation outputs. However, it seemed that readModels was unable to read and extract the standardized coefficients for me. Attached is one of my mplus outputs. If you can provide the solutions for this problem, I would greatly appreciate it.
> >
> > Thanks,
> > Nick
